# Verifies the submitted answer {B, D} against the stated definition of the
# "trolley management method". Each option is annotated with the definition's
# four conditions. The annotations are interpretive judgments taken from the
# option text, so the check is a rule-based test of those annotations, not a
# proof from the question itself.
from itertools import combinations
from fractions import Fraction

# Definition conditions:
#   C1: service objects (recipients) are integrated into the service system
#   C2: their resources are tapped to help improve management
#   C3: provider benefits
#   C4: recipients benefit (win-win)
CONDITIONS = ("C1_integrated", "C2_uses_recipient_resources",
              "C3_provider_benefits", "C4_recipient_benefits")

# Annotations from the option text (True = condition evidenced in the text).
facts = {
    "A": {"C1_integrated": True,  "C2_uses_recipient_resources": True,
          "C3_provider_benefits": True,  "C4_recipient_benefits": True},   # parents' labor; school saves money
    "B": {"C1_integrated": True,  "C2_uses_recipient_resources": True,
          "C3_provider_benefits": True,  "C4_recipient_benefits": True},   # customers' stools; sales up; customers feel cared for
    "C": {"C1_integrated": False, "C2_uses_recipient_resources": False,
          "C3_provider_benefits": False, "C4_recipient_benefits": True},   # self-service, no provider in the system
    "D": {"C1_integrated": True,  "C2_uses_recipient_resources": True,
          "C3_provider_benefits": True,  "C4_recipient_benefits": True},   # customers' bags; supermarket gains image and savings
}

def satisfies(opt):
    return all(facts[opt][c] for c in CONDITIONS)

# Exhaustive enumeration of all 2^4 option subsets, checking which one
# exactly equals the set of options meeting every condition.
options = sorted(facts)
qualifying = {o for o in options if satisfies(o)}
print("Options meeting all four conditions:", sorted(qualifying))

for r in range(len(options) + 1):
    for combo in combinations(options, r):
        s = set(combo)
        if s == qualifying:
            print("Exact-match subset found:", sorted(s))

submitted = {"B", "D"}
print("Submitted answer:", sorted(submitted))
print("Ratio of submitted to qualifying (exact):", Fraction(len(submitted & qualifying), len(qualifying)))

if submitted == qualifying:
    print("CHECK PASS")
elif submitted < qualifying:
    print("Missing options:", sorted(qualifying - submitted))
    print("CHECK FAIL")
else:
    print("Extra options:", sorted(submitted - qualifying))
    print("CHECK FAIL")

# Note: samples/annotations are judgments from text; a definitional question
# cannot be settled by pure computation beyond this rule-based test.
